title: Launch countdowns stop at 10-15 seconds with craft seen

tellings.quote: get down to 10 or 15 seconds and it stops then everything's normal again crazy and people rolling up on these sites have sometimes seen those crafts and they blow away

plain: In the 1970s at the Ellsworth missile field in South Dakota, nuclear missile launch countdowns are said to have started by themselves, run down to 10 or 15 seconds, then stopped, with everything back to normal. A former nuclear missile guard named Mario Woods tells Michels that people driving up to the sites sometimes saw craft there that then shot away, which would mean something was tampering with the nuclear arsenal.
